_howto: Guided setup for Fuel (Demo / Setup mode).
title: Set up Fuel
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it. Each step checks itself against what you've set up.

steps.title: What the app must capture
steps.why: Odometer and photo rules for fuel issues, how efficiency is shown, and delivery rules.

steps.title: Farms and field units
steps.why: Where fuel is used. The same farms and units as Production Pay.

steps.title: Fuel activities
steps.why: What fuel is used for, and which activities qualify for the diesel rebate.

steps.title: Fuel prices
steps.why: The price per litre from a date, so every issue is costed.

steps.title: Depots and pumps
steps.why: Your tanks and the pumps that dispense from them.
steps.todo: At least one depot or tank.

steps.title: Vehicles and assets
steps.why: Everything that gets fuel, with its current reading.
steps.todo: At least one vehicle or asset.

steps.title: Drivers
steps.why: Who issues and receives fuel, linked to the user they log in to the app as.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Record a refill into a tank.
  2. Issue fuel to a vehicle (on the app, or add a fuel log).
  3. Check the tank level, the cost and the efficiency on the Dashboard.
  4. Run a consumption report.
Fuel logs, refills and readings are never pushed to live.
